note: D1-G authored names (LAW.md L3.2, L3.5, L2.8, L1.3, L5.2). Dominance finds a module; a person names it here where the root's own name would erase an authored concept (G-03). Every value is taken from B's pass-3 authored names (pass-3/B-kit/authored/names.json) unless its `why` says otherwise. `names`: unit name -> root file name -> the dir's name, or {collapse} (the root heads no dir). `bases`: unit name -> parent dir relative to the unit -> the base module's name (L2.8). `stage1`: a stage-1 target that lands loose in a container, or would close an FD-2 pair, takes a module dir. `groups`: a stage-1 moved file (key) -> the files of its dir that move with it (L1.3). Paths appear only as keys: F-1 reads every JSON value as a potential path. `rename`: a file's authored name (path or file name -> new file name). `modules`: the pinned module set (E3N). `testNames`: a test's authored name where two tests of one name meet in one slot. `carve` (L7.2): a peer dir over 12 that no dominator child splits -> module name -> the file names it holds, taken from B's pass-3 carve; a carve of a kind slot names modules of the slot's unit.
